temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is dedicated to his work but is overworking to an unhealthy degree and may benefit from rest and a new perspective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's refusal confirms that his hospital workload is very demanding and that he is currently unwilling or unable to step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is severely overworked and resistant to taking a break, so simple encouragement may not be enough to protect his health.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and worried, with some disappointment that Gary declined help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue trying to support Gary and find another way to help him address his overwork.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him gently, Gary says the situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is overworked because of hospital demands and has been reluctant to take time away, but Ethan still believes the main issue may be professional overcommitment.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restless behavior and refusal to discuss work suggest the overwork is tied to deeper, complicated issues he has been hiding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dealing with something more than ordinary work stress and has been carrying it alone, needing nonjudgmental support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and increasingly worried about what Gary is hiding.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Gary that he can trust Ethan, encourage him to open up, and offer help without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing. He agrees with Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is facing deep, complicated pressures beyond routine overwork and has been reluctant to share them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan now understands the specific reasons behind Gary's overwork: managing a new department and personal challenges, and Gary is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's situation is difficult but understandable, and it can improve through task prioritization, delegation, and better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Gary organize his schedule and find a healthier work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in regularly with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, he is less overwhelmed, and he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is willing to change and has accepted help, but Ethan believes Gary still faces challenges and needs ongoing support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reports and visible efforts show that the support and planning are producing real improvement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making meaningful progress, is less overwhelmed, and is capable of continuing to improve with encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. He thanks Ethan for his support and says he feels much more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary has been improving and managing better, but Ethan still believes Gary may benefit from ongoing support and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary has achieved a stable, healthier balance and appears capable of managing on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary no longer needs active intervention; Ethan can step back while remaining available if Gary ever needs help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied and happy for his friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Step back from active involvement and let Gary manage independently, while staying available if needed.
